speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you've had a tympanoplasty and are experiencing occasional shooting ear pain with difficulty wearing earrings; can you tell me exactly how many days it has been since your surgery?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient has a history of polycystic ovarian syndrome, depression, and chronic bilateral ear infections. She underwent right ear tympanoplasty 12 weeks ago. Although audiology report from one week ago showed improved hearing by 20 decibels, she reports occasional shooting pain when eating and discomfort when wearing earrings. She describes her job as stressful and mentions poor sleep quality.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient reports shooting pain when eating and discomfort with earrings; is this right-sided pain also accompanied by a feeling of fullness or ringing in the ear? REQUEST TEST: High-Resolution CT Temporal Bone.

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: High-Resolution CT Temporal Bone requested; previous audiology findings indicate improved hearing by 20 decibels post tympanoplasty. ENT examination reveals right postauricular tenderness upon tapping correlating with right tonsillar area discomfort. Patient reports shooting pain when eating and discomfort with earrings. No specific data provided in current records confirming presence of fullness or ringing in the ear.
